name: Echo CS-4510
blurb: A 45 cc saw: 16″, 18″ and 20″ bars on .325″ chain, .050″ gauge, 66–78 drive links per Echo's own chart.
intro: The Echo CS-4510 is a 45 cc saw on .325″ pitch .050″ chain. Echo's specification table lists 16″ and 18″ bars, and Echo's Bars and Chains chart adds a 20″ bar (20B0AD3378C, 78 drive links of 20BPX78CQ). This is the step up from 3/8″ low-profile: a different pitch, so the loops are not interchangeable with the CS-310 family.

bars.note: Echo bar 20B0AD3378C; chain 20BPX78CQ. From Echo's Bars and Chains chart (CS-4510 block; the spec table lists 16″ and 18″).
